sql: SELECT 'market_catalog' AS source, count(*) AS rows, count(DISTINCT ticker) AS tickers, min(created_at)::text AS first_seen, max(updated_at)::text AS last_seen FROM markets WHERE ticker LIKE 'KXEARNINGSMENTION%' UNION ALL SELECT 'market_snapshots', count(*), count(DISTINCT market_ticker), min(captured_at)::text, max(captured_at)::text FROM market_snapshots WHERE market_ticker LIKE 'KXEARNINGSMENTION%' UNION ALL SELECT 'orderbook_snapshots', count(*), count(DISTINCT market_ticker), min(captured_at)::text, max(captured_at)::text FROM orderbook_snapshots WHERE market_ticker LIKE 'KXEARNINGSMENTION%' UNION ALL SELECT 'execution_order_context', count(*), count(DISTINCT market_ticker), min(decided_at)::text, max(decided_at)::text FROM execution_order_context WHERE market_ticker LIKE 'KXEARNINGSMENTION%'
